meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 执行 Bash 命令时会被自动转发给 rtk 代理,压缩令牌消耗;对 git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令可节省 60–90% 令牌。
howto.when: 当 Claude 要运行 Bash 工具命令(如 git、cargo、pytest 等)时会自动触发。

say.note: 该命令会通过 rtk 代理执行,节省令牌。
同样由 rtk 处理,减少令牌用量。

say.text: 执行 docker ps 查看容器
say.note: Bash 调用会被 rtk 自动拦截。

howto.what_en: After installation, every Bash command run by Claude is automatically routed through the rtk proxy, compressing token usage; on dev commands like git, cargo, pytest it can save 60–90% tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically whenever Claude is about to run a Bash tool command (such as git, cargo, pytest, etc.).

say_en.note: The command goes through the rtk proxy to save tokens.
Handled by rtk, reducing token usage.
Bash calls are intercepted by rtk.
